item.text: The page currently waits for one dashboard fetch before it can render any of its content. I’m moving that fetch behind section-level Suspense boundaries so the title and section placeholders can be part of the pre-rendered shell, while the stats, chart, and invoices resolve as streamed content.

Updated [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:13) so the dashboard title and section placeholders can render in the partial pre-rendered shell while the stats, revenue, and invoices load behind separate Suspense boundaries. The sections share a React-cached dashboard fetch, so they reuse one request.

`git diff --check` passed. I didn’t run the test suite.
